title: 第17章 服用解药改第18章 遭遇伏击改
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
极阴与天煞帮的关系，很是微妙。
一方面，双方各自防备着对方，都怕对方图谋不轨。
另一方面，双方又都需要借助对方的力量。
极阴需要天煞帮给他找各种灵药，抓捕十余岁识字的年轻人。
天煞帮则借助极阴是仙人的名号，威慑一些强大武者和乾国朝廷，让他们不敢轻易对天煞帮动武。
唐梁为了修仙，也曾经去偷听过极阴的早课，但得到的只是些只言片语，不得其法。
那些没能成功修炼的年轻人，都是在极阴的监视下，被处决的。让唐梁想从那些年轻人身上，得到修炼之法的设想，胎死腹中。
唐梁神情阴沉，眼中满是不甘。
“哪个凡人不想成为仙人，可是仙缘岂是轻易能得到的。”
苟航叹息一声，“少帮主这般英雄豪杰，都接触不到仙缘，我这样的小喽啰就更没希望了。可是，一个路边小乞丐，都能得到仙缘，少帮主却不能，这仙缘真是让人捉摸不透。”
唐梁眉头紧锁，“什么小乞丐？”
苟航道，“少帮主，你还不知道吗？极阴长老收了一个亲传弟子，以前就是个小乞丐。”
唐梁闻言，一脸不屑，“我还以为，哪个小乞丐命好，捡到了仙法呢。极阴长老的亲传弟子，何止一个，最后的结果嘛...嘿嘿。”
苟航道，“这次可不一样，极阴长老应该是真收了个弟子，那人可以自由进出天煞帮。极阴长老以前那些弟子，可是连极阴长老的院子都走不出。”
唐梁眉头一挑，“此话当真？”
苟航道，“我岂敢欺骗少帮主，那人叫宋文，还是我带入天煞帮的，少帮主一查便知。刚刚我还遇到他了。”
“走！带我去找那人。”
唐梁心动了，他不敢对极阴动手，还对付不了一个十几岁的小年轻吗？
苟航神情一僵，急忙拉着已经走出几步的唐梁。
“少帮主，你要做什么？”

“当然是找那人，索要修仙之法。”唐梁一副理所当然的道。
“少帮主，此事不可鲁莽。万一，那宋文不识好歹，他不愿意交出呢？”
苟航的目的，可不是让唐梁获得修仙之法，而是要彻底解决宋文这个隐患。
若宋文当真把修炼之法交给了唐梁，那他可就白忙活了。
唐梁眼神一瞪，“他敢不给！”
苟航道，“就算他交出了修仙之法，他回去之后，将此事禀报给极阴长老，少帮主又该如何应对？”
唐梁沉思片刻，“你说的有几分道理，以前还真没有看出来，你苟航还有几分脑子。那你说，该怎么办？”
苟航压低声音，轻声道，“自然要暗中行事，将宋文直接绑了，问出修炼之法后，直接弄死。这样一来，就神不知，鬼不觉。在行动之前，我们还要摸清宋文的实力。”
片刻之后，唐梁点了点头，“此事若是能成，以后你就跟在我身边吧，你这脑子还挺好用的。”
“多谢少帮主赏识。”
苟航眼中溢彩连连，他有些兴奋。当真是一石二鸟，不仅能处理了宋文这个威胁，还得到了少帮主的赏识。

content_en:
The relationship between Jiyin and the Tiansha Gang is very delicate.
On the one hand, both sides are on guard against each other, fearing that the other side may be up to no good.
On the other hand, both sides need to rely on the strength of the other.
Ji Yin needs the Tiansha Gang to find various elixirs for him and arrest literate young people in their teens.
The Tiansha Gang used the name of Ji Yin as an Immortal to intimidate some powerful warriors and the imperial court of the Qian Kingdom, so that they would not dare to use force against the Tiansha Gang easily.
In order to cultivate immortality, Tang Liang once eavesdropped on Jiyin's morning class, but what he got was only a few words, which was incomprehensible.
Those young people who failed to practice successfully were executed under the supervision of Jiyin. Tang Liang's idea of ​​obtaining the method of cultivation from those young people was stillborn.
Tang Liang's expression was gloomy, his eyes full of unwillingness.
"Which mortal doesn't want to become an immortal, but immortality is not easily obtained."
Gou Hang sighed, "A hero like the young gang leader can't get the chance of immortality, and a little guy like me has no hope. However, a little beggar on the roadside can get the fate of immortality, but the young gang leader can't. This fate is really unpredictable."
Tang Liang frowned, "What little beggar?"
Gou Hang said, "Young leader, don't you know? Elder Jiyin has accepted a direct disciple, who used to be a little beggar."
Hearing this, Tang Liang looked disdainful, "I thought that some little beggar had a good life and picked up the immortal magic. There is more than one direct disciple of Elder Jiyin, and the final result...hehe."
Gou Hang said, "It's different this time. Elder Jiyin should have really accepted a disciple, and that person can enter and exit the Tiansha Gang freely. Elder Jiyin's former disciples couldn't even leave Elder Jiyin's courtyard."
Tang Liang raised his eyebrows, "Is this true?"
Gou Hang said, "How dare I deceive the young gang leader? That man's name is Song Wen, and I brought him into the Tiansha Gang. The young gang leader will know after checking. I met him just now."
"Let's go! Take me to find that person."
Tang Liang's heart was moved. He didn't dare to attack Ji Yin. Why couldn't he deal with a teenager?
Gou Hang's expression froze and he hurriedly pulled Tang Liang, who had already taken a few steps away.
"Young Gang Leader, what are you going to do?"
"Of course I'm looking for that person to ask for the method of cultivating immortality." Tang Liang said matter-of-factly.
"Young Gang Leader, don't be reckless in this matter. What if Song Wen doesn't know what's good and what's wrong, and he's unwilling to hand it over?"
Gou Hang's purpose was not to let Tang Liang obtain the method of cultivating immortals, but to completely solve Song Wen's hidden danger.
If Song Wen really handed over the cultivation method to Tang Liang, then his work would have been in vain.
Tang Liang glared, "How dare he deny it!"
Gou Hang said, "Even if he hands over the method of cultivating immortals, how should the young gang leader respond if he reports the matter to Elder Jiyin after he returns?"
Tang Liang pondered for a moment and said, "What you said makes sense. I never saw it before. You Gou Hang still has some brains. What do you think we should do?"
Gou Hang lowered his voice and said softly, "Of course we have to act in secret. We will tie up Song Wen directly and kill him after asking about the method of cultivation. In this way, the gods will not know and the ghost will not notice. Before taking action, we have to find out Song Wen's strength."
After a moment, Tang Liang nodded, "If this can be done, you can stay with me from now on. You have a pretty good mind."
"Thank you, Young Gang Leader, for your appreciation."
Gou Hang's eyes were filled with color and he was a little excited. He really killed two birds with one stone. Not only was he able to deal with the threat of Song Wen, he was also appreciated by the young gang leader.
